Verified by reading the diff.

Fixed in 4cf099d (on top of dd00a9e): reopening a repeating task takes back its untouched next copy; finishing again reuses a touched one. Verified in the diff.
Fixed in 4cf099d (on top of dd00a9e): finishing again reuses the existing copy instead of creating a second one. Verified in the diff.

Fixed in 4cf099d (on top of dd00a9e): apply-flow calls through callAction, so a dropped connection returns an error instead of replacing the page. Verified in the diff.

Fixed in 4cf099d (on top of dd00a9e): the proxy hands /p pages their path, and sign-in and the first-password step return there through a strict same-origin validator (src/lib/portal/next-path.ts). Verified in the diff.
Fixed in 4cf099d (on top of dd00a9e): contractors return to the job after sign-in (next= through login and first password). Verified in the diff.
Fixed in 4cf099d (on top of dd00a9e): the Scheduled email reads "scheduled it for Thu, Oct 29", also when assigning an already Scheduled job (notifications/content.ts). Verified in the diff.

Fixed in 0148abf (on top of 4cf099d): every Portal access card action runs through thenRefresh, which revalidates the contractor page in a finally block, so after a lost Create login response the retry gets "already has a login" back with a fresh card showing Reset password instead of Create. Partly fixed in 9f74ea1: the legacy link script would attach the email-valued names (zack@outlawcarpentry.com, fallettaidrius@gmail.com) to Zack's and Idrius's Contacts, so those 6 open tasks would stop reading Unassigned, but it hasn't been run. The unchecked list path is gone. Still open, as design calls for Connor: there's no 'Reassign anyway' action on the refusal, and a reassign still has no Undo toast the way Due does.

Still open at 9f74ea1: nothing changed for this. The 14 missing contractor emails are data only Connor can supply. /contractors still has no portal-readiness column or filter, and the Portal access card still doesn't warn about shared-looking addresses such as info@ or office@. Both are design calls for Connor.

Fixed in 9f74ea1: Shared staff and system comments, status lines and files now record the contractor assigned at the time, set in setStatus, addComment and recordAttachment. The portal timeline, the new-update counts, the gallery and the file route all show a staff row only to that contractor, or to anyone when no contractor was assigned. Imported Asana rows stay visible. Rows written before the migration have no audience (no backfill), so staff replies already on a job still show to the next contractor. The assign-toast copy (I04) is a separate finding. The migration session expects no such rows in production (CSV tasks were never linked to contacts, and main had no app-created tasks or attachments as of Oct 22), so no backfill is planned. Production wasn't queried to confirm.

Still open at 9f74ea1: on a job whose contractor has no login, the task page still reads 'Visible to Zack', 'Shown to Zack' and 'Reply to Zack', and nothing loads the assignee's portal status. The fix is small once the copy is picked, so this is a copy and design decision for Connor.

Partly fixed in 9f74ea1: photos still held when the contractor moves to another page in the app now post as their own update, except ones a Mark done is still sending. The browser asks before a reload or a closed tab while photos are held, but iOS Safari never asks. addComment now refuses a files-only post whose files another post already took. Still open: photos are still held while the composer has text, the 'N uploads ready to send' state is still there, closing the Mark done sheet still posts nothing, and on iOS a reload or closed tab still loses the notification. Whether photos post as soon as they upload, and whether closing the sheet posts them, is Connor's call.

Partly fixed at 9f74ea1: the beforeunload guard on a reload or closed tab exists, but it landed earlier in 4cf099d. 9f74ea1 only moved it into a reusable useLeaveWarning hook, with no change in behaviour for uploads still going up. Still open: BackLink and in-app back still unmount the uploader and abort every upload without a prompt, there is no 'Uploading 2 of 5' pill on To do or Scheduled jobs, and the uploader isn't lifted into the portal layout. The BackLink sheet and the pill are design calls for Connor.

Partly fixed in 9f74ea1: firstName now uses a one-word nickname in parentheses, so 'Jacob (Jake) hoak' greets as 'Jake' in the My jobs heading, the Mark done payoff and the login text. Still open: contacts named after a company still come out as 'Hi Dust', 'Hi Fox' and 'Thanks, Fox!'. There's no First name field on PortalAccount and no company fallback ('Your jobs', 'Thanks!'), which is a data and design decision for Connor.

Partly fixed in 9f74ea1: the portal's own firstName in job-view.ts now calls the names.ts helper, so the two can't disagree, though the wrapper is still there. Still open: business contacts 'Fox Pest' and 'Dust 2 Sparkles' still come out as 'Fox' and 'Dust'. No 'Called' short-name field was added to Contact, and cleanup-contacts.ts leaves company names alone. Whether to add the field or fix the contact data is a decision for Connor.

Fixed in 9f74ea1: initials() now strips non-letters, drops anything in parentheses and reads a name containing '@' as an email's local part, so 'Jacob (Jake) hoak' gives 'JH'. Tests were added. It takes the first two words rather than the first and last, so a three-word name like 'Mary Ann Smith' gives 'MA'. 'fallettaidrius@gmail.com' still gives 'F' because its local part is one word.

Still open at 9f74ea1: OFFICE_PHONE_E164 is still an empty string in code, so the 'Call HG' button never shows. The only change is that officeTelHref now reuses telHref. Connor needs to supply the number (or choose a per-job 'Call Connor' row), and moving the number into app config is still a code fix.

Fixed in 9f74ea1: the one email template now has a <head> with a utf-8 charset meta and a width=device-width viewport meta, and render.test.ts checks for them. The G1A-032 color-scheme metas aren't in the block (that's a separate finding). Nothing in git shows the manual check in iOS Mail, Gmail iOS or Outlook iOS was run.

Partly fixed in 9f74ea1: Sign in, Email me a link and both Save password buttons now use AuthSubmit (disabled, with 'Signing in…', 'Sending…' and 'Saving…'), and failures on /login, /login/forgot, /login/reset and /p/welcome/password now show AuthCrash inside the sign-in frame instead of Next's white page. Still open: the Sign out button on /p/welcome/password is still a plain button with no pending state, which is a small code fix. The migration session holds the Sign out pending label as a copy question for Connor, recommending to leave it.

Fixed in 9f74ea1: the login form now runs through useActionState, so a failed POST is caught by the new src/app/login/error.tsx, which shows 'No connection. Try again when you have signal.' and Try again inside the dark AuthFrame, and the typed email comes back after the retry. The recovery is a full frame screen rather than the inline line suggested, and no src/app/global-error.tsx backstop was added.

Fixed in 9f74ea1: login() returns { error, email } through useActionState instead of redirecting to /login?error=bad, so the email field keeps what was typed (defaultValue), the password clears on React's form reset, and focus moves to the password field. The email never goes in the URL.

Partly fixed in 9f74ea1: a wrong password now comes back inline with the email kept and the password field focused, with no email in the URL. Still open: there is no show-password toggle on the login, reset or first-password fields, which the other session left for Connor as a design decision.

Fixed in 9f74ea1: the proxy now overwrites x-hg-app-path on every staff section request, requireUser redirects to /login?next=<path and query>, and login() sends staff to that path after checking it with staffReturnPath. That check only accepts Home or the seven (app) sections, never /p, and rejects '//', backslashes, control characters and dot segments.

Fixed in 9f74ea1: signed out, /tasks/<id> now redirects to /login?next=/tasks/<id>. A successful staff sign-in goes there, and contractors still go to their /p page. Anything unsafe or out of scope falls back to '/' or My jobs. Because a failed attempt no longer redirects, the hidden next field survives it.

Fixed in 9f74ea1: a signed-out GET of a staff page now redirects to /login?next=<path>, and a save after the session expires goes to the same URL for the page it was posted from (withResult rethrows the redirect), so sign-in returns to the task. The suggested in-place 'Signed out. Sign in again' toast was not built, so the unsaved edit is still dropped on that bounce.

Fixed in c805e38 (after 9f74ea1): texted task and record links already returned to the record after sign-in, and now a signed-out browser visit to /api/files/<kind>/<id> gets a 307 to /login?next=<file> and comes back to the file. Fetches still get a 401, and the staff return-path validator accepts only /api/files/(task|property)/<id>. Verified in the diff.

Still open at 9f74ea1: the importer still writes no dueOffsetDays, the anchor picker still shows only when an item has an offset, and it still defaults to today, so every imported playbook creates undated tasks. The offsets are content for Connor, and the always-visible empty anchor, anchor quick picks and dated-count button are design calls for him too.

Still open at 9f74ea1: nothing adds offsets to NEW TENANT or NEW MOVE OUT, and the importer's template items still carry no dueOffsetDays, so the apply form never asks for the move-in date and all 10 tasks land undated. Connor has to choose the offsets (content) before cutover.

Still open at 9f74ea1: the importer's TemplateItem still has no dueOffsetDays field and the build loop never sets one; only the app-side parser reads the field, as it already did at 0148abf. The importer field is a small code change, but it only helps once Connor provides the per-step offsets (content).

Still open at 9f74ea1: createNextRepeat still steps once from the finished copy's due date with no roll-forward, so a copy finished more than one interval late is created overdue. There is still no completion toast naming the next date. This changes plan section 5.2, so it is Connor's decision.

Still open at 9f74ea1: the next copy is still nextOccurrence(rule, previous due) with no catch-up past today, and there are no On schedule or After done modes. This waits on Connor's call to change spec 5.2.

Still open at 9f74ea1: a monthly task due Sep 1 closed on Oct 22 still creates a copy due Oct 1, because createNextRepeat steps once from the previous due date. No completion toast names the next date. This waits on Connor's decision to change plan section 5.2.

Still open at 9f74ea1: weekly rules still store no weekday and step 7 days from the last copy's (possibly moved) due date, so moving one copy still moves the whole series. Pinning a weekday changes approved spec 5.2, so it is Connor's decision.

Partly fixed in 9f74ea1: quarterly now saves dayOfMonth from the due date's day, so Aug 31 goes Nov 30, Feb 28, May 31, Aug 31, and the chip reads "Quarterly on the 31st". Still open: yearly is deliberately left unpinned, so Feb 29 still slides to Feb 28 for good (Connor's call), and quarterly rules saved before this commit only get the pin when re-saved.

Fixed in 9f74ea1: New task's Repeats now takes its day from the Due date (or today when there is none). Choosing a repeat with no Due fills Due with the first occurrence, and changing Due moves a day that came from it, so Due Nov 15 gives Monthly on the 15th. The server also dates an undated repeating task on create and patch. The suggested "First one due" line in the panel was not added; the filled Due field shows the date instead.

Fixed in 9f74ea1: titleOf now runs applyTokens over the hand-edited title as well, so filling Tenant after editing a title clears its [Tenant]. That clears the red border, the hint and the disabled Create, which all read from titleOf.

Partly fixed in 9f74ea1: [tenant name] now shares the Tenant field, [Address], [property] and [property address] map to one address key, and labels read in sentence case. Notes and checklist scanning and case-insensitive matching were already there at 0148abf. Still open: the address still shows as an editable field instead of never being asked, and [tenant number] is labeled "Tenant number" rather than "Tenant phone"; both are design or copy calls for Connor.

Partly fixed in 9f74ea1: Tenant and tenant name are now one field, labels are sentence case, email and number fields get type=email and type=tel, and the hint uses the field label. Still open: "Property address" is still an editable input repeating the property, notes-only values (Tenant email, Tenant number) still block Create and their notes still aren't shown, and the hint copy and "Tenant name" / "Tenant phone" labels aren't the recommended wording. These are design and copy calls for Connor.

Partly fixed in 9f74ea1: the Asana load report now has an "Open tasks with [brackets] in the title, to rename" section that lists every open bracketed title with its task id and section. Still open: there are no inline rename fields, and the 8 renames themselves are a data task for Connor in the load review.

Fixed in 9f74ea1: Approve (REVIEW to DONE) now writes 'approved "..."', the email line reads 'Connor approved it' like the job page, and the subjects read 'Connor approved Cabinet install' and 'Connor sent back Cabinet install'. Both cases are covered in content.test.ts and core.test.ts.

Fixed in 9f74ea1: Approve reads 'Connor approved it', and 'started the job' is written only for a contractor's own Start, so a partner's move reads 'Connor moved it to In progress' in both the email and the portal Updates. The extra payoff copy ('Thanks, Zack.') and a 'See job' button were not added (the button is still 'Open job'), and that copy is left to Connor.

Partly fixed in 9f74ea1: when the latest status change in the bundle is sent back, scheduled or approved, the subject now says so ('Connor scheduled Cabinet install for Fri, Oct 30', using the latest date in the email). Still open: target moved, target cleared, comments, files, notes and a contractor's Start still arrive as 'X updated T'. Subjects still never include the property, titles aren't shortened, and the partner-side 'Zack finished' form wasn't added. The outcome-first subject wording is Connor's copy decision.

Fixed in 9f74ea1: the outbox now selects the task's unitLabel, and the job line names the unit the way My jobs does, so 'Bathroom tile' with unit 2 emails as 'Bathroom tile, 415 Crescent Ave · 2'. Two small gaps: a bare number reads '· 2' rather than 'Unit 2', and the suffix is still added when the title already names the unit.

Still open at 9f74ea1: the Portal access card still gets only active = portalAccount.status === 'ACTIVE' and lastSignIn. The page doesn't select mustChangePassword or session lastUsedAt, so a login nobody has used still shows the green Active badge. The new badge states and their copy (Invited, Active with last seen, Access off) are a design and content decision for Connor, and the code follows from that.

Still open at 9f74ea1: contact.active is still not passed to the Portal access card, so an inactive contractor with a login shows Active and the full set of actions even though sign-in and emails refuse him. The 'Access off: contractor is inactive' state and its actions are Connor's design and copy call, and the code then needs to pass the flag through.

Partly fixed in 9f74ea1: the directory Phone column and the record's Phone are now tel: links, and Email is a mailto: link, in the same text style with underline on hover. Still open: there's no sms: Text link on touch, no maps link for the mailing address, no Copy button, and phone numbers inside notes are still plain text (Steve Fuller's after-hours line). Those extras are left to Connor.

Whether this should be a field is Connor's call.

Partly fixed in 9f74ea1: repeated trades are dropped on display, both importer merge passes now de-dupe the same way, and scripts/cleanup-contacts.ts lists (and with --apply writes) de-duped trades and capitalized lowercase name words. It's a dry run by default and is gated for production. Still open: nobody has run it, so 'John detzler' and the others still show lowercase. Partly fixed in 9f74ea1: the global search placeholder now reads 'Search addresses, contractors, tasks…'. Still open: search results still label a contractor 'Vendor', which needs the w-16 type column widened, a layout call for Connor. The directory subtitle still reads 'N contractors & service providers', a plain copy fix that wasn't made and isn't in the claim.

Partly fixed in 9f74ea1: the placeholder no longer says vendors. Still open: it's a single string with no short form below 640px, so on a 375 phone the longer 'Search addresses, contractors, tasks…' still truncates. The short mobile copy ('Search') is a small copy and code change that hasn't been made.

Partly fixed in 9f74ea1: the placeholder reads 'Search addresses, contractors, tasks…'. Still open: a search for Zack still returns 'VENDOR Zack Reading · Outlaw Carpentry', because the result type is still 'Vendor'. 'Contractor' needs a wider type column, which is held as a layout question for Connor.

Fixed in 9f74ea1: where field-sizing:content is supported, the title textarea no longer gets an inline px height, so it re-fits when the width changes. Where it isn't supported, the JS fallback now re-measures through a ResizeObserver whenever the width changes, covering a rotated phone or a narrower window. I read the code but didn't re-run the resize test. The 24px size is still tracked in TASKS-015.

Partly fixed in 9f74ea1: every unit in Property.units gets a stable id on its next save, and a rename carries to the property's tasks and listings in the same transaction when the old and new labels are each unique. Still open: Task.unitLabel and Listing.unitLabel are still free-text labels with no unitId, and the lockbox code is still resolved by label. Removing a unit doesn't ask first, and a non-unique rename or a removal still leaves stale labels, so the lockbox card disappears without warning. The unitId columns are a schema decision for Connor.

Still open at 9f74ea1: the move-in report's createTask still sets no due date or assignee, so the task still trails the dated rows in Unassigned and comes last on the property Tasks card. Setting Due to the arrival day is a one-line code change, but it is held as Connor's call.

Fixed in 9f74ea1: the property Tasks card now marks a past Target red with the same red as Today's date chip, using Today's late rule (never Waiting or Review). It drops the year for the current year ('Aug 28'), and overdue tasks still sort first by the soonest-date order.

Fixed in 9f74ea1: the rebuilt card colors late dates red using isTargetLate, which excludes Review and Waiting, and drops the current year, so 767 Prospect's Mud Drywall reads a red 'Aug 28' as on Today. One small difference: the card uses isTargetLate for staff tasks too, so a staff task in Scheduled is judged by its visit date. For every other status that is the same as isOverdue.

Fixed on main and live on production (4b9b14f, 3390e7d; the data migration confirmed in the live database). The move-in submit goes through callAction: a dropped connection shows the offline message and every answer stays.

Fixed on main in fa4c400 (fix batch 2, financials): Same banner fix: the 'mid-update' copy is gone, it states the gap and date, and 'Review' links to /financials/settings#cleanup.

Fixed on main in fa4c400 (fix batch 2, financials): 'Unattributed (entity / no-class) ... real cost, no property' is now 'Not assigned to a property' with '$X in · $Y out' on the Overview tile, the By property row (link now reads 'Map classes' and goes to #class-mapping) and the Settings cleanup list. Fixed on main in fa4c400 (fix batch 2, search): Both findings were still present in the code at b40a4ec. src/components/global-search.tsx now follows the WAI-ARIA combobox pattern with a listbox popup. The input has role combobox, aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant, aria-label and autoComplete off. Results are buttons with role option, aria-selected and tabIndex -1. The first result is highlighted when results arrive, and the highlight uses the existing hover fill, so nothing is restyled. Arrows move the highlight and wrap, Enter opens it, Esc closes the list and a second Esc clears the text, and Tab closes the list. Esc stops propagation so it doesn't also close the mobile nav drawer. A slow response for an older query no longer replaces newer results (stale flag), and a dropped connection no longer throws (try/catch). The search uses fetch, not a server action, so callAction doesn't apply. Left: SHELL-001: I didn't rebuild on React Aria ComboBox. It would mean moving the dropdown into a portal Popover, which changes the layout. Its Esc handling also differs from the spec: it clears or reverts the text on the first press. React Aria Autocomplete, which the assignee picker uses, doesn't set role combobox or aria-expanded. So I fixed it in place with the hand-written APG pattern. The Popover move from the 'Old popovers' known gap is still open. SHELL-001: a Cmd+K shortcut to focus search, key hints in the footer and the full-screen phone sheet (SHELL-005) are new features and were not built.

Fixed on main in fa4c400 (fix batch 2, search): New pure helpers in src/lib/search.ts: searchTerms, everyTermMatches and foldAccents, tested in src/lib/search.test.ts. /api/search now splits the query into words and requires every word to match some field, in any order. Each word is tried as typed, without accents, and with street words in both forms through normalizeAddress, so 'Avenue' finds 'Ave.' and 'Rd' finds 'Road'. Tasks now also match on their property or deal address, the staff assignee name, the assigned contractor's name and the legacy assigneeName. The reported cases now match: '647 Prospect Avenue', '118 Congress Street', 'congress roof', 'framing mariner', and 'José' finding 'Jose Alvarez'. Two files outside the area changed minimally. src/lib/normalize.ts: the street-word table is now the exported STREET_WORDS, so the search can map short forms back to long ones; normalizeAddress output is unchanged and its tests pass. docs/components.md: the GlobalSearch row and the 'Old popovers' known gap are corrected. Left: IA-I01: accents stored in the database still block matches. Typing 'Jose' won't find a stored 'José', for example in a task's legacy assigneeName. Fixing it needs the Postgres unaccent extension (or pg_trgm), or a stored normalized searchText column, and either one needs a migration. IA-I01: the '118 Congress St.' sublabel under task results is a visual change and waits for Connor's approval. IA-I01: a 'No matches' row when a search finds nothing (at every width, not only 320px) is a new empty state and was not built.
